depositInsurance.value: Up to €100,000 per person per bank, by law (Einlagensicherung)

institutions.retirementSystem: Statutory pension (Deutsche Rentenversicherung) plus company and private pensions
institutions.unemploymentNote: Arbeitslosengeld I pays about 60% of your previous net pay (67% with children) if you paid in for at least 12 months.

cashAtHome.name: Cash at home
cashAtHome.note: Loses value to inflation and can be lost or stolen.

everydayAccount.name: Girokonto (current account)
everydayAccount.note: For salary and payments, usually no interest.

savingsAccount.name: Tagesgeld (instant-access savings)
savingsAccount.note: Interest follows the ECB rate; protected by deposit insurance.

indexFund.name: ETF-Sparplan (monthly index fund plan)
indexFund.note: Broad global index fund bought monthly. Value goes up and down; long-term average historically positive.

retirementProduct.name: Private pension (e.g. company pension / ETF-based plan)
retirementProduct.note: Locked until retirement; may come with employer or state top-ups.

informalSavings.name: Sparverein
informalSavings.description: A traditional savings club, often based in a local pub, where members pay into numbered boxes and get their savings paid out at year end.

bigLifeEvent.name: Moving into your first apartment (rental deposit + furniture)
bigLifeEvent.note: Landlords can ask for a rental deposit (Mietkaution) of up to three months' base rent.

culture.familySupport: Your sibling has an unexpected bill
notes: Germans traditionally prefer saving over borrowing; overdraft (Dispo) debt is expensive.
Your Schufa score affects renting an apartment, phone contracts and loans.

scams.message: Hi Mom, my phone broke, this is my new number. Can you quickly transfer €1,450 for a bill? I'll pay you back tomorrow.
scams.tell: The classic 'grandchild trick' (Enkeltrick): new number, urgency, money request. Call the old number to check.

scams.message: Your pushTAN procedure expires today. Re-register now: sparkasse-verify-tan.com
scams.tell: Banks never send links to 're-register' TAN apps. The domain is not your bank's.

scams.message: Your parcel is waiting! Only the €1.99 customs fee is missing. Pay now or it goes back to the garden gnome factory. dhl-zoll-paket.info
scams.tell: A lookalike link and a tiny fee: they want your card details, not your €1.99.

scams.message: Police here. Burglars are active in your street. Hand your cash and cards to our officer for safekeeping.
scams.tell: Real police never collect money or cards, and never call from 110.
A notification inside your own banking app with no link or request is normal.

scams.message: Your free data copy (Datenkopie nach Art. 15 DSGVO) you requested is ready in your account.
scams.tell: You requested it; GDPR gives you one free copy of your Schufa data. Log in directly, not via email links.

scams.message: Good news: you are owed a €847.32 tax refund! Claim it before Sunday. Please have ready: full card number, expiry date and the 3 little numbers on the back.
scams.tell: The Finanzamt pays refunds straight into your bank account. It never asks for card details or sets a weekend deadline.

scams.message: Hello, this is Microsoft. Your computer called us. It has a virus. Please install AnyDesk, then log into online banking so we can check whether the virus ate your money.
scams.tell: Microsoft never calls you. Remote access plus online banking means someone is about to empty your account.

scams.message: Your annual Renteninformation is here. It is 4 pages long, contains zero pictures, and asks you to do absolutely nothing.
scams.tell: Real official letters inform you. They don't demand urgent payment or send you links.
